verdict.rationale: Paddle is a billing SaaS platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. However, the evidence documents no Paddle CLI. The MCP servers, server-side SDKs, Postman collection, OpenAPI spec, and agent-skill plugins for third-party CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) are adjacent tools or developer building blocks, not a first-party Paddle command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
